title: AI product photography that still looks like your product
seoTitle: AI product photography: a step-by-step guide
description: Make AI product photography from real photos of your real product. Get a shot list, scene prompts, checks before you publish and honest ad rules.
lede: AI product photography works when you start from real photos of the real product. Let AI build the scene while the product itself stays accurate. This guide gives you a reusable shot list, three prompts to copy, a check to run before you publish and the current rules for AI images in advertising.
